persons.name: Jayajitāmitramalla
persons.evidence: sumatijayajitāmitramallo mahīndraḥ ... śrīśrījayajitāmitramallavarmanā svakarena likhitaṃ saṃpūrṇaṃ

date.as_written: śrī nepālasamvat 802 vikramāditya saṃvat 1738 kaligatasaṃvat (4772) śake samvat 1603 phālhuṇamāse kṛṣṇapakṣe paṃmyāyā(!)tithau svātinakṣatre dhruvayoge kathākalanamuhutake(!) bēhapati(!)vāsare

notes: The catalogue records NS 776 from an earlier note ('saṃ 776 jyeṣṭha vadi 8 goyacchoyā dina'), but the main colophon records the completion in the King's own hand ('svakarena likhitaṃ') on NS 802 Phālguṇa kṛṣṇa 5 (matching VS 1738, Śaka 1603, Kali 4772).
